diagnosis: Repeated operations are overrepresented in candidate/bad runs, especially repeated clicks, no-ops/waits, and scrolls.
expected_mechanism: Detecting unchanged state after repeated operations forces strategy adjustment, reducing unproductive loops and operation cost. The tradeoff is small state-tracking overhead and occasional premature switching when repetition is genuinely necessary.
policy_text: Track the observable state before and after each operation. If the same or equivalent operation fails to produce meaningful progress twice, do not repeat it unchanged; diagnose the blocker and switch target, method, or strategy. Repeat again only when new evidence makes success plausibly different.

quantitative_evidence.command: jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[]=="result:repeated") | [.value,.labels.source_session[0]] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\t' '{if($1>0){p+=$1;ps[$2]=1}else{n+=-$1;ns[$2]=1}} END{for(x in ps)pc++;for(x in ns)nc++;printf "bad=%d bad_sessions=%d good=%d good_sessions=%d net=%d ratio=%.3f\n",p,pc,n,nc,p-n,p/n}'
quantitative_evidence.finding: Repeated operations: bad=1,485 across 88 sessions; good=224 across 20 sessions; net bad excess=1,261; bad/good count ratio=6.629.

quantitative_evidence.command: jq -r '[.value,(.stack_frames|map(select(startswith("result:")))[0])] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\t' '$2=="result:repeated"{if($1>0)p+=$1;else n+=-$1} {if($1>0)tp+=$1;else tn+=-$1} END{printf "bad_share=%.4f (%d/%d) good_share=%.4f (%d/%d) ratio=%.3f\n",p/tp,p,tp,n/tn,n,tn,(p/tp)/(n/tn)}'
quantitative_evidence.finding: Repeated operations constitute 20.16% of bad-side operations (1,485/7,366) versus 5.93% of good-side operations (224/3,780), a 3.402× relative share.

quantitative_evidence.command: jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[]=="result:repeated") | [.value,(.stack_frames|map(select(startswith("action:")))[0])] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\t' '{if($1>0)p[$2]+=$1;else n[$2]+=-$1} END{for(k in p) print k,p[k],n[k]+0,p[k]-(n[k]+0)}' | sort -k4,4nr
quantitative_evidence.finding: Largest repeated-action excesses are click +639 (679 bad vs 40 good), noop +356 (441 vs 85), and scroll +277 (278 vs 1).
